description: FrankyRenderer is an open-source DirectShow video renderer based on MPC Video Renderer and libplacebo with HDR tone mapping, Dolby Vision Profile 7 auto-detection, and custom shaders.
post_install: $c = 'using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; using Microsoft.Win32; public class FrankyReg { [DllImport("advapi32.dll")] public static extern int RegOverridePredefKey(IntPtr h, IntPtr n); [DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet=CharSet.Unicode)] public static extern bool SetDllDirectory(string p); [DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet=CharSet.Unicode)] public static extern IntPtr LoadLibrary(string p); [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr GetProcAddress(IntPtr m, string n); [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] public static extern bool FreeLibrary(IntPtr m); public delegate int F(); public static int Reg(string p, bool u) { RegistryKey k = Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey(@"Software\Classes"); IntPtr h = k.Handle.DangerousGetHandle(); RegOverridePredefKey(new IntPtr(unchecked((int)0x80000000)), h); RegOverridePredefKey(new IntPtr(unchecked((int)0x80000002)), h); SetDllDirectory(System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(p)); IntPtr m = LoadLibrary(p); if (m == IntPtr.Zero) { SetDllDirectory(null); RegOverridePredefKey(new IntPtr(unchecked((int)0x80000000)), IntPtr.Zero); RegOverridePredefKey(new IntPtr(unchecked((int)0x80000002)), IntPtr.Zero); k.Close(); return -1; } IntPtr f = GetProcAddress(m, u ?
